questions.q: What is the molecular shape of Xenon Tetrafluoride (XeF₄)?
questions.qPa: Xenon Tetrafluoride (XeF₄) ਦੀ ਅਣੂ ਸ਼ਕਲ (molecular shape) ਕੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Xe has 8 valence electrons. SN = 1/2(8 + 4) = 6. This means sp³d² hybridization (Octahedral geometry). Since there are 4 F atoms, LP = 6 - 4 = 2. Two lone pairs on an octahedral geometry result in a Square Planar shape.

questions.q: What is the hybridization of the central atom in the Triiodide ion (I₃⁻)?
questions.explanation: Treat one I as central. Valence e- = 7. Monovalent surrounding atoms = 2. Anion charge = +1. SN = 1/2(7 + 2 + 1) = 5. SN=5 corresponds to sp³d hybridization.

questions.q: According to VSEPR theory, which of the following repulsive interactions is the strongest?
questions.explanation: Lone pairs occupy more space around the central atom than bond pairs. Therefore, the repulsion between two lone pairs is the strongest (LP-LP > LP-BP > BP-BP).

questions.q: What is the Steric Number (SN) and the resulting geometry for the Sulfate ion (SO₄²⁻)?
questions.explanation: Central atom S has 6 valence e-. Oxygen is bivalent, so M=0. Charge is -2, so A=2. SN = 1/2(6 + 0 + 2) = 8/2 = 4. SN=4 means Tetrahedral geometry.
